about: Timing budget for driving this car with a swarm. Inputs only: tools/budget.py derives dead time, blind and stopping distance, plan horizon and speed caps per operating point from these and latency.json. Replace estimates with measurements and re-run; requirements follow. The twin section holds the thresholds car-twin's latency/realtime/camera/tracker checks grade against.

lateral_margin_m.note: free lane each side of the car

coast_decel_mps2.note: spec.json vehicle; stop publishes throttle 0, so the car coasts

brake_decel_mps2.note: active braking via a reverse-throttle pulse

watchdog_s.note: relay stops the car this long after its plan expires or the link drops

servo_step_deg.note: typical correction; slew time = step / spec.json steer_slew_deg_per_s

paths.note: wan is dropped when the relay sits on the car's LAN

twin.about: Thresholds the car-twin checks use. The twin must be tighter than what it models.
